name: xayven
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Xayven instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Xayven tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Xayven through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Xayven Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Xayven only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
